edges.reason: Constructor assigns the immutable _token field from the token argument.
Constructor assigns the immutable _beneficiary field.
Constructor assigns _releaseStartTime after truncating to a full day.
Constructor computes and assigns _releaseEndTime.
Constructor assigns the total benefit amount.
Constructor initializes _withdrawedBalance to zero.
Constructor initializes the termination flag to false.
Constructor calls _setOwner(_msgSender()), making the deployer the owner.
Constructor validity check compares _releaseEndTime against block.timestamp.
releasedBalance() outcome depends directly on block.timestamp.
terminate() uses block.timestamp to set the new release end time.
_msgSender() returns the caller-controlled msg.sender value.
Constructor uses _msgSender() to derive the initial owner.
owner() is compared against _msgSender() in the onlyOwner modifier.
onlyOwner modifier gates the privileged terminate() function.
isNotTerminated modifier gates terminate() so it can run once.
isNotTerminated modifier reads the _isTerminated flag.
withdraw() requires releasedBalance() to exceed the withdrawn amount.
terminate() recomputes the total benefit from releasedBalance().
releasedBalance() scales the stored total benefit amount.
releasedBalance() uses _releaseEndTime to bound the vesting period.
releasedBalance() uses _releaseStartTime to count elapsed days.
releasedBalance() divides elapsed seconds by SECONDS_OF_A_DAY.
terminate() truncates block.timestamp using SECONDS_OF_A_DAY.
Constructor parameter token_ is stored into _token.
Constructor parameter beneficiary_ is stored into _beneficiary.
Constructor parameter releaseStartTime_ is stored into _releaseStartTime.
Constructor parameter daysOfTimelock_ shapes the computed _releaseEndTime.
Constructor parameter totalBenefit_ is stored into _totalBenefit.
Local amount is the value transferred to the beneficiary.
Local amountToWithdraw is the value transferred to the owner.
passedDays multiplies the total benefit in the release formula.
totalDays is the divisor in the release formula.
_totalBenefit is scaled by passedDays/totalDays.
Beneficiary address is the recipient of the external token transfer in withdraw().
Owner address is the recipient of the external token transfer in terminate().
_withdrawedBalance is updated by adding the newly released amount.
The arithmetic update writes back into the _withdrawedBalance state variable.
External ERC20 transfer can re-enter withdraw() before state is fully settled.
External ERC20 transfer in terminate() can re-enter the contract.
amountToWithdraw is derived from the externally queried token balance.
terminate() sets _releaseEndTime from the block.timestamp value.
Timestamp-derived value overwrites the _releaseEndTime state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: token_ exists only to initialize _token in the constructor and should collapse into that function.
beneficiary_ exists only to initialize _beneficiary in the constructor.
releaseStartTime_ is only consumed while computing the immutable release window.
daysOfTimelock_ is only used to derive _releaseEndTime during construction.
totalBenefit_ is only stored into _totalBenefit in the constructor.
amount is the transient value passed straight into the token transfer in withdraw().
amountToWithdraw is the transient value passed into the owner token transfer in terminate().
passedDays only exists inside the releasedBalance arithmetic expression.
totalDays only exists as the denominator of the releasedBalance arithmetic expression.
